description:
Because:

* The 2.x eslint-plugin-playwright rules flag faults in the tests
* denormalizeStoredEmail used a Node variable in page.evaluate

This commit:

* Upgrades eslint-plugin-playwright to ^2.12.1 in functional-tests
* Fixes denormalizeStoredEmail so it uppercases the stored email
* Uses web-first assertions where the new rules ask for them

Closes FXA-11367
